name: desk
title: Service desk handover
subtitle: Internal review. Demo records are fictional. Times are UTC.

sections.title: Open tickets
sections.sql: select token,location,service,clerk,status,wait_minutes from queue_now order by queued_at

sections.title: Open calls
sections.sql: select token,location,clerk,service_minutes from queue_now where status='called' order by service_minutes desc

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by minutes desc

sections.title: Service outcomes by UTC arrival day
sections.sql: select service_date,location,service,imported,interactions,served,no_shows,removed from daily_performance order by service_date desc,location,service
sections.note: Imported snapshots are separate from live records. Counts describe interactions, not unique visitors.

sections.title: Waiting and service duration
sections.sql: select service_date,location,service,imported,mean_wait_minutes,mean_service_minutes,over_target from daily_performance order by service_date desc,location,service
sections.note: Mean wait uses called interactions. Mean service uses ended interactions with a call time. Unknown imported durations are excluded.

sections.title: Clerk activity
sections.sql: select * from clerk_performance order by location,clerk
sections.note: Service mix differs. These figures are not an employee ranking.

sections.title: Purpose and retention review
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by token,rule
sections.note: These are evidence checks, not a legal certification. Retention is set by your organisation.
